amendments.title: Shared training horizon, widened tuning grid, pre-finals gates
amendments.trigger: First Study A v2 final campaign launched under the pre-amendment values below, stopped after 47 of 105 rows, and quarantined.
amendments.scope_note: Changes training.tuning_rounds, training.final_rounds, tuning.local_lr_multipliers, and tuning.server_learning_rates only. Does not change cohort, client, instrument, dgp, certification, model, primary_aggregation_weighting, selection_metric, tie_breaker, test_used, or final blocks, and does not modify checksummed data artifacts (cohort_metadata.json, frozen_client_list.json, cohort.csv).
reasons: Tuning/final horizon mismatch: hyperparameters selected at a 150-round budget were used unverified for a 500-round campaign.

Grid-edge selection: all six (g0, method) tuning groups selected the ceiling of both tuned axes (learning_rate=0.002, server_learning_rate=1.5), with validation MSE decreasing monotonically across the whole grid and no interior optimum.
Non-convergence: at 150 tuning rounds, 29 of 36 runs peaked at round 149 (the final round); the 500-round horizon-confirmation runs then peaked at round 499 in 6 of 6 cases.

prefinals_gates.convergence_gate: If best_validation_round falls within the last 5% of comm_round for more than 20% of runs in any (g0, method) group, the horizon is insufficient: extend it and re-tune. Do not proceed to finals.
prefinals_gates.grid_edge_gate: The at_grid_edge flag computed by scripts/select_eicu_study_a_v2_tuning.py must be False for all six (g0, method) groups. An edge selection means the search did not find an interior optimum and the grid must be widened again.

evidence.measurement_conditions: equal_client_val_mse metric, seed 1011, learning_rate=0.002, server_learning_rate=1.5. All probe runs were validation-only diagnostics, never used for hyperparameter selection; the test split was never read.
evidence.grid_edge_evidence: All six (g0, method) tuning groups selected learning_rate=0.002 and server_learning_rate=1.5, the ceiling of both grids, with monotonically decreasing validation MSE across all 36 candidates.
evidence.non_convergence_evidence: 29 of 36 runs peaked at round 149 of 150; 30 of 36 peaked within the final 10 rounds. All 6 horizon-confirmation runs at 500 rounds peaked at round 499.
evidence.horizon_probe_consequence: The 500-round horizon captured essentially 100% of the maximum advantage FedOGDA ever holds on linear (peak at round 487), and the sign of the FedGDA-vs-FedOGDA difference reverses by round 700. At 500 rounds the campaign would have reported FedOGDA ahead on 2 of 3 structural functions; at 2000 rounds FedGDA is ahead on 3 of 3.
evidence.why_4000_not_2000: interaction had not converged at 2000 rounds -- still improving 6.7% per 250 rounds at round 1750, with best_validation_round=1999. mlp converges fastest and begins overfitting after round 1184. The protocol selects the best-validation checkpoint, so a longer shared horizon is safe for fast-converging families.
evidence.why_drop_lr_0p0005: At 2000 rounds lr=0.0005 reached only 1.348 (linear/FedGDA) versus 0.340 at lr=0.002 -- four times worse, and still descending 40.5% over the final 500 rounds. Not a distinct optimum, only a slower path to the same place.

unchanged: decision_rule (favored at >=4/5 wins per g0 and >=12/15 pooled with sign agreement; otherwise inconclusive)
